name: nipmod
description: Use Nipmod as Codex's pre-install decision and safety layer for packages, SDKs, tools, models, repositories, containers, and MCP servers.

interface.longDescription: Nipmod gives Codex a pre-install decision layer: detect package-selection tasks, search package sources, compare candidates, inspect trust evidence, return risk and install boundaries, then require explicit approval before local package manager writes.
defaultPrompt: Find the best auth package for this Next.js repo and show the Nipmod install boundary before changing anything.
Before installing anything, use Nipmod to choose a safe PDF parser for this Python backend.
Use Nipmod to compare MCP servers for documentation search and show the exact approval packet.
